title: Sentinel-2 L2A RGB Satellite Imagery (PMTiles) - Riyadh Governorate, Saudi Arabia
description: RGB satellite imagery of Riyadh Governorate, Saudi Arabia, derived from Sentinel-2 L2A data captured between July 1–14, 2024. Distributed as a single PMTiles archive suitable for web-based tile visualization. Processed from the Element84 Earth Search STAC catalog using the Tabaqat satellite tool.

## README.md

# Sentinel-2 L2A RGB Satellite Imagery (PMTiles) - Riyadh Governorate, Saudi Arabia
![Riyadh Sentinel](https://i.imgur.com/saiubwz.png)
# Overview
This dataset includes (PMTiles) RGB Of Sentinel-2 L2A Satellite Imagery of Riyadh Governorate, Saudi Arabia Captured from (1 to 14) July 2024 ,
derived from https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1 by Tabaqat satellite tool 
which is one of Tabaqat GeoApps tools provided by https://tabaqat.net/.

# Observe it in use
You can use https://pmtiles.io/ to get a quick overview to see it in action through shared URL provided here 
https://data.source.coop/tabaqat/riyadh-satellite-pmtiles/riyadh_governorate.pmtiles at specified zoom extent.

# Files and Structure
- `riyadh_governorate.pmtiles` - PMTiles file of Riyadh Governorate.
- `README.md` - This file, explaining the repository.

# Data Sources: 
  This dataset was compiled by tabaqat satellite tool from https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1.

# Data Formats:
the data is provided in this format: 
- PMTiles is a single-file archive format for tiled data, usually used for visualization. As an “archive format”, PMTiles is similar to a ZIP file: 
it contains the contents of many individual files inside of one PMTiles file. you can explore more information about PMTiles, from here https://guide.cloudnativegeo.org/pmtiles/intro.html.

# Data Access: 
Generating PMTiles From Sentinel Satellite Imagery Produced By Tabaqat Satellite Tool is explained in our blog post https://tabaqat-wagtail.tabaqat.net/en/resources/blogs/generating-pmtiles-from-sentinel-satellite-imagery-produced-by-tabaqat-satellite-tool/. 

# Data Upload Process
Data Upload Process Steps are explained in our blog post https://blogs.tabaqat.net/en/unlocking-spatial-insights-a-guide-to-uploading-geoparquet-files-onto-source-cooperative-platform-for-enhanced-data-collaboration/ which is valid for any data format.

# Contact 
For further details about the dataset or the processing steps, you can contact us via https://platform.tabaqat.net/contact-us.
